description.en: Animated React components with spring physics built on shadcn/ui and Motion.
description.zh: 融入弹簧物理动效的高质感 React 组件库，基于 shadcn/ui 与 Motion 构建。

content.en: Nexvyn UI delivers meticulously crafted, animated React components powered by spring physics and fluid micro-interactions. Built on top of Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS, and Motion, it is fully compatible with the shadcn/ui CLI registry protocol and supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for AI coding workflows.
content.zh: Nexvyn UI 是一套专注于弹簧物理动效与流体微交互的高质感 React 组件库。全面基于 Radix UI 底层原语、Tailwind CSS 与 Motion 构建，严格遵循 shadcn/ui CLI 注册表协议并原生支持 MCP 规范，让 AI 助手与设计工程师均能无缝按需引入兼具触觉手感与工程规范的现代界面控件。
